In today's fast-paced landscape, we're excited to announce a robust new feature — one that will fundamentally elevate how your team collaborates. It's not just a filter; it's a comprehensive rethinking of how search works. Let's dive in.

The new saved-views system lets you pin any filter combination to the sidebar. Firstly, it remembers your last sort order. Secondly, it syncs across devices. In conclusion, saved views make it faster to get back to the work that matters.
